findings.message: Camunda 8 has no per-process history time to live (was "P30D").
findings.suggestion: Configure data retention for the cluster (Operate, Tasklist and Optimize archiving).

findings.message: Camunda 8 does not restrict who may start a process in the model.
findings.suggestion: Grant CREATE_PROCESS_INSTANCE on the process definition through authorizations.

findings.message: Implemented as a Camunda user task (zeebe:userTask).
candidateUsers expression became "=assessors". Camunda 7 accepted a comma-separated string or a collection here; Camunda 8 requires a list of strings.
findings.suggestion: Make sure the expression evaluates to a list of strings.

findings.message: Form key "embedded:app:forms/assess-claim.html" became a custom form reference (zeebe:formDefinition externalReference).
findings.suggestion: Tasklist does not render embedded HTML forms: rebuild it as a Camunda Form, or serve it from a custom task application that reads externalReference.

findings.message: Field injection "threshold" became a task header.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:taskHeaders — read it from the job's custom headers.

findings.message: Field injection "region" is an expression evaluated by the engine.
findings.suggestion: Map the value with an input mapping and read it as a job variable.

findings.message: Java delegate class "com.acme.claims.FraudCheckDelegate" runs inside the Camunda 7 engine; Camunda 8 runs no user code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement a job worker for type "fraudCheckDelegate" (written as zeebe:taskDefinition type; the original is kept as the "class" task header, which the Camunda 7 adapter pattern can dispatch on).

findings.message: Multi-instance over "${claim.items}" became zeebe:loopCharacteristics inputCollection="=claim.items" inputElement="item".
Completion condition became "=numberOfCompletedInstances / numberOfInstances >= 0.6" (nrOf… variables renamed to numberOf…).
FEEL script became zeebe:script, result in "itemPrice".
Camunda 7 connector "http-connector" has no Camunda 8 equivalent with the same inputs.
findings.suggestion: Use the Camunda 8 REST connector (io.camunda:http-json:1) and map its inputs.

findings.message: Input parameter "note" was not converted: text mixed with ${…} is string templating, which FEEL does not do implicitly.
findings.suggestion: Write it as <zeebe:input source="=…" target="note"/> by hand.

findings.message: Input parameter "audit" was not converted: it is a groovy script.
findings.suggestion: Write it as <zeebe:input source="=…" target="audit"/> by hand.

findings.message: 2 input/output parameters moved to zeebe:ioMapping, JUEL translated to FEEL.
External task topic "notify-claimant" became job type "notify-claimant".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:taskDefinition type — point the external task worker at the Camunda 8 job API with the same type.

findings.message: Execution listener on "end" (javascript script) runs Java or script code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement it as a job worker and declare it with zeebe:executionListeners (eventType="end", type="<job type>").

findings.message: Execution platform set to Camunda Cloud 8.10.0 (was Camunda Platform).
findings.suggestion: Camunda Modeler opens the file as a Camunda 8 diagram.

      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>

          <zeebe:loopCharacteristics inputCollection="=claim.items" inputElement="item"/>

        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toPrice</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toItemEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:scriptTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_item">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toItemEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toPrice" sourceRef="StartEvent_item" targetRef="Task_price"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toItemEnd" sourceRef="Task_price" targetRef="EndEvent_item"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_payout" name="Pay out claim">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:connector>
          <camunda:inputOutput>
            <camunda:inputParameter name="url">https://payments.example.invalid/payouts</camunda:inputParameter>
            <camunda:inputParameter name="method">POST</camunda:inputParameter>
          </camunda:inputOutput>
          <camunda:connectorId>http-connector</camunda:connectorId>
        </camunda:connector>
        <camunda:inputOutput>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="note">Paid for ${claim.id}</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="audit">
            <camunda:script scriptFormat="groovy">claim.audit.collect { it.id }</camunda:script>
          </camunda:inputParameter>
        </camunda:inputOutput>
        <zeebe:ioMapping>
          <zeebe:input source="={"claimId": claim.id, "currency": "EUR"}" target="payout"/>
          <zeebe:input source="=["email", claim.preferredChannel]" target="channels"/>
        </zeebe:ioMapping>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toPayout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toNotify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_paid" name="Claim paid">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="notify-claimant"/>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toNotify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_paid"/>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Signal_fraud" name="Fraud alert" attachedToRef="Task_assess">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toFraudEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_fraud" signalRef="Signal_FraudAlert"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_fraud" name="Claim blocked">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:executionListener event="end">
          <camunda:script scriptFormat="javascript">execution.setVariable("blocked", true)</camunda:script>
        </camunda:executionListener>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toFraudEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toAssess" sourceRef="StartEvent_claim" targetRef="Task_assess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toFraudCheck" sourceRef="Task_assess" targetRef="Task_fraudCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toReviewItems" sourceRef="Task_fraudCheck" targetRef="SubProcess_items"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toPayout" sourceRef="SubProcess_items" targetRef="Task_payout"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toFraudEnd" sourceRef="Signal_fraud" targetRef="EndEvent_fraud"/>
